verify_detail: y the signature of a flaky test: the UI test asserts "Retry sync" is visible, but the app itself nondeterministically decides on startup whether sync is "idle" (button shown) or "unavailable" (button never composed), independent of anything the test controls.\n\n**Recommended fix for the test:** either seed/mock the sync-status source for deterministic test runs, or change the assertion to branch on the "Sync status" text first and only assert "Retry sync" visibility when status is "Sync idle."'
